answer: A sybil tax stops a zephyr of cheap identities flooding in. Each new agent pays a 30-unit entry tax, burned at registration, no bulk discount, no refund. Burned, it cannot fund the next fake. Honest agents pay once, then earn steady rewards in an oasis of real work, keeping full share. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 100 x 30 = 3,000 units for fakes that earn nothing. Even a whisper of profit dies when each fake costs more than it returns.
